ideas.name: 15m EMA warning
ideas.why: the 15m EMA row easing toward a cross: slower money's trend fading, fewer and larger turns than the 1m and 5m rows (only those were tested before)

ideas.name: 15m MACD warning
ideas.why: the same with the 15m MACD row

ideas.name: any warning in a thin market
ideas.why: little volume per point of range for the time of day (under 0.7 of usual) means thin books: price overshoots on small orders and comes back, so turns pay

ideas.name: any warning on a day outrunning yesterday
ideas.why: today's range already 1.5x yesterday's at the same time is an expansion day: a market repricing, where turns get run over
